files.behavior: EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY source with eligible:false / NOT_ACTIVATED is counted as available; registry-derived stale sources are grouped without eligibility revalidation.
files.consequence: An unavailable external source can satisfy the current-authority boundary.
files.remediation: Consume only server-verified eligible authority/source sets; exclude denied residue from authority groups, cards and refs; localize presentation labels.

files.behavior: Trusts incoming bundle.sources and coverage flag; stale denied Book I/V material can become answer and citation. Raw authority category codes are projected.
files.consequence: A stale intermediate bundle can support a denied-source answer; source labels expose implementation classes.
files.remediation: Revalidate source provenance against the existing admission owner before composition/citation; derive coverage from surviving evidence, deduplicate identities, reject unusable evidence and use localized customer labels.

files.behavior: Broader-knowledge policy leaves supplied sources unchanged; ignores current admission on stale objects, retains duplicate/malformed/unusable sources.
files.consequence: Denied or unusable objects enter the grounding bundle. Published Book V source-reading fallback is a separately owned bounded publication path, not proof of whole-chapter qualification.
files.remediation: Filter and validate trusted source identity/provenance before grounding, preserve public-publication authority separately from private whole-chapter admission, deduplicate and fail safely on malformed inputs.

files.behavior: Retains sourceEvidence even with NO_SUPPORTED_ANSWER; returns governance lineage, internal source IDs/hashes/version fields, raw unknown strings and source-class labels. Atlas ZH copy contains Registry evidence. Synthetic local path in excerpt survives.
files.consequence: Denied metadata and internal wording reach the response; provenance/body residue can be displayed.
files.remediation: Explicit public allowlist; suppress denied/unusable sources including no-supported-answer residue; sanitize client-facing unknown/error text and localize Book/Article/Figure/Concept/World/external/no-source labels without changing canonical titles.

files.behavior: Verifies corpus byte/source identity but assumes upstream admission; standalone loader/search does not consult current closure and can materialize a denied stale candidate.
files.consequence: Normal R4 API stays gated; downstream reuse is not independently fail-closed. No remote client injection exploit is demonstrated.
files.remediation: Require server-verified admitted scopes/provenance for whole-chapter materialization and search, using existing R4 owner/gate; preserve identity checks and bounded public knowledge units.

sharedAuthority: Reuse functions/_lib/manuscript-current-admission.js and CHAPTER-CURRENT-CLOSURE.json; no second ledger.
